result.quote: may fire come from Abimelech and consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and may fire come from the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo and consume Abimelech.
result.reason: The curse is mutual destruction: fire from Abimelech is to consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and fire from those leaders is to consume Abimelech. The key is incomplete because it omits Beth-millo and inaccurately broadens “the leaders of Shechem” to Shechem generally.
